mapper.select: /* ApprovalLineMapper.selectApprovalLineByReqId */ SELECT A.REQ_ID AS reqId , A.APPROVAL_STEP AS approvalStep , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.APPROVER_USER_CD AS approverUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.APPROVER_USER_CD, null) AS approverUserNm , A.APPROVAL_STATUS AS approvalStatus , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', A.APPROVAL_STATUS, 'SYS044') AS approvalStatusNm , A.APPROVAL_COMMENT AS approvalComment , DATE_FORMAT(A.APPROVAL_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS approvalDate FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ_APPROVAL A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.REQ_ID = #{reqId} ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_STEP ASC
